propositions: reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contains ~200 lines of untestable, unlintable YAML-based production logic (staleness classification and two alert-ticket lifecycle state machines) that cannot be validated by ruff or standard Python tooling

Logic families (classification, heartbeat-alert lifecycle, binding-drift-alert lifecycle) must migrate from YAML run-blocks to Python module scripts/canary_bridge.py as four subcommands while preserving error handling dispositions and DRY_RUN gates
Both CAS push loops (reconcile-bridge.yml commit-back and canary flush) remain in YAML byte-identical and tested verbatim; only the branchy decision-logic moves to Python
Anti-rot test must pin canary YAML wiring (no new logic-bearing run-blocks reappear; invocations remain thin) and workflow parity must be operator-attested post-merge via workflow_dispatch run
